body: Flexible and powerful data analysis / manipulation library for Python, providing labeled data structures similar to R data.frame objects, statistical functions, and much more
plain_description: pandas is the must-have toolkit for anyone who works with data in Python. It lets you clean, transform, merge, and analyze datasets from spreadsheets, databases, and flat files — fast and without boilerplate code. The bottom line: if you need to make sense of tabular data, pandas saves you hours of manual work.
technical_description: pandas is a Python library that provides high-performance, easy-to-use data structures (Series and DataFrame) and data analysis tools. It implements labeled data structures with automatic alignment, integrated handling of missing data, a full-featured group-by engine for split-apply-combine operations, and time-series-specific functionality including date-range generation and moving-window statistics. The library supports robust I/O for CSV, Excel, SQL databases, HDF5, and Parquet, and integrates with NumPy for numerical computation. pandas is available via pip and conda.
title: pandas
